d: At Stumps on Day 4 of the 1st Test in Wellington, New Zealand finished at 119/2 in 45 overs in their second innings, still trailing India by 233 runs. Resuming overnight on 55*, Rishabh Pant smashed 128 off 153 balls before falling to Rachin Ravindra. With this knock, Pant equaled Brendon McCullum for the second-most sixes in Test history (107).
